case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised friendly, attentive staff, cleanliness, pleasant outdoor areas with an inviting pool and bar, and a good breakfast; several noted family-friendly space and tidy, welcoming rooms with amenities like toiletries and parking. Reported negatives included intermittent noise (including local paddle tennis), an episode of scalding shower water, and at least one comment about an uncomfortable bed causing back pain.
